title: Playboy January 2007 Pamela Anderson Holiday Anniversary Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Light corner wear at the lower corners of the front and light scuffs on the back cover; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 2007 Holiday Anniversary Issue. Original $6.99 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Pamela Anderson in black and white.

Cover features: The Passion of Pam - Pamela Anderson pictorial; 12 stellar Playmates; T. Boone Pickens interview; 20Q with Ellen Pompeo; the story of SportsCenter with Keith Olbermann, Dan Patrick and Chris Berman; Jimmy Breslin on immigration; Robert Stone on starting out; Neal Gabler on the cover model; new fiction by Walter Mosley.

Back cover: Woodford Reserve bourbon ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
